messages:
maya: Heads up — releasebot bumped 1.4.2 -> 1.5.0 for a docs-only PR. That feels wrong. Anyone else seeing this? :confused:

deploy-bot: releasebot: created release 1.5.0 for PR #4821 (docs: changelog entry). Reason: 'changelog significant' — triggered minor bump.

raj: That's odd. Minor bump implies feature/breaking. Docs shouldn't change semver unless content affects API. Was there a changelog template tick?

maya: PR had 'changelog: API' in the template but only link updates. So template misused.

lin: We should tighten the releasebot heuristic: only minor if 'api' label + code changes. If only docs, skip bump. Also consider a 'docs-only' label to force skip.

sarah: Agree. Also about pinned deployments — Dedicated customers expect patch bumps only for hotfixes. We accidentally rolled forward to 1.5.0 in staging and some pins broke.

deploy-bot: Notice: route 'staging' pinned to 1.4.x; auto-rollforward applied because 1.5.x was compatible per metadata. Rolled forward at 06:12 UTC.

raj: That auto-rollforward rule is dangerous when minor bumps happen for non-code reasons. Maybe add 'rollback-safe' metadata that releasebot sets to false on minor bump unless code changes present.

maya: Or simpler: change releasebot to never do minor bump for docs-only; only patch. And have explicit 'force-minor' flag for exceptions.

lin: Propose: docs-only -> no semver bump. Changelog-only -> patch. Code + public API change -> minor. Breaking -> major. Also update tagging convention to append +meta if buildmeta only (e.g., v1.5.0+meta).

sarah: We also need a migration path: there are already a couple of releases wrongly bumped. Action: add a rollback decision doc and schedule a runbook for pinned customers.

maya: I'll open a releasebot PR with heuristic changes and add a rollout-check that warns before auto-rollforward on minor bumps. Assigning to @raj to review. :memo: 

raj: I'll review. Also we should publish a short note for PMs about 'changelog taxonomy' so people don't misuse templates.

deploy-bot: action created: issue #512 in infra/releasebot — 'docs-only bump heuristics' assigned to maya. ETA: 48h.

maya: Thanks. Anyone object to the tagging convention 'vX.Y.Z+meta' for buildmeta-only releases? It's machine-friendly.

lin: No objections. Please also add a small lint in the PR template that flags 'changelog: API' when no code diff touches src/ or public/ paths.

sarah: Once the PR lands, let's have the releasebot runbook updated and notify customer success about potential pin fallout.

maya: Will do. Closing loop here — will post PR link and a brief adoption note in #general when merged. :shipit:
